srtToVtt.title: SRT to VTT
srtToVtt.description: Convert SRT subtitles to WebVTT format
srtToVtt.seoTitle: Convert SRT to VTT Online Free | ConvertMyFilePro
srtToVtt.seoDescription: Free online SRT to VTT converter. Convert SubRip subtitles to WebVTT format instantly. Private, no upload required.

faq1.q: What is the difference between SRT and VTT?
faq1.a: SRT (SubRip) uses commas for milliseconds (00:00:01,000) while VTT (WebVTT) uses dots (00:00:01.000). VTT also supports additional styling options like text positioning and colors.

faq2.q: Will I lose any timing information?
faq2.a: No. The conversion preserves all timestamps, text content, and formatting. Only the timestamp delimiter changes from comma to dot.

faq3.q: Can I convert multiple SRT files at once?
faq3.a: Yes. You can batch convert up to 20 SRT subtitle files to VTT format simultaneously.

vttToSrt.title: VTT to SRT
vttToSrt.description: Convert WebVTT subtitles to SRT format
vttToSrt.seoTitle: Convert VTT to SRT Online Free | ConvertMyFilePro
vttToSrt.seoDescription: Free online VTT to SRT converter. Convert WebVTT subtitles to SubRip format instantly. Private, no upload required.

faq1.a: Many media players and video editors prefer SRT format. SRT is more widely supported across different devices and software platforms.

faq2.q: Does VTT to SRT conversion change the timing?
faq2.a: No. All timestamps and text content remain exactly the same. Only the format changes from WebVTT to SubRip standard.

faq3.q: Will my subtitles lose WebVTT styling?
faq3.a: SRT format only supports plain text without styling. Any position, color, or font settings from VTT will be removed during conversion.

txtToSrt.title: TXT to SRT
txtToSrt.description: Convert plain text files to SRT subtitles
txtToSrt.seoTitle: Convert TXT to SRT Online Free | ConvertMyFilePro
txtToSrt.seoDescription: Free online TXT to SRT converter. Turn plain text into subtitled SRT files. Fast, private, no download required.

faq1.q: How does TXT to SRT conversion work?
faq1.a: The tool splits your text into segments based on paragraphs. Each segment becomes a subtitle block with auto-calculated timing based on reading speed.

faq2.a: The auto-timing uses ~15 characters per second. For precise timing, we recommend using SRT editing software after conversion.

faq3.q: What is TXT to SRT good for?
faq3.a: Perfect for creating subtitles from transcripts, scripts, or lyrics. Great for YouTubers, educators, and content creators who need quick subtitles.

secure.question: Is my data secure?
secure.answer: Yes! All file processing happens directly in your browser. Your files never leave your device or get uploaded to any server.

free.question: Is this service free?

quality.question: Will my image quality be affected?
